title: Easy Tagg v2.9.10.98
message: Complete global theme audit with consistent light and dark interfaces.
releaseNotes: Centralizes theme colors across the complete app, removes unintended black surfaces in Light Mode, corrects text, placeholder and number contrast, adapts icons and native controls, keeps active tabs orange, and synchronizes the installed APK version with the GitHub release metadata. Preserves the approved dark strike zone and player cards, fast roster ordering, tagging, History, exports and sync behavior.
